verdict.rationale: Cognee ships an official `cognee-cli` documented in first-party docs, supporting core memory operations (remember, enrich, ask questions) from the terminal without opening Python, plus cloud push, report generation, and an offline demo mode. This is a genuine, well-documented CLI tailored to its agentic/memory workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the CLI's reliability beyond vendor docs.
